inventory.text: The flat marker labels a reported under-four-minute result, not an equality or a measured x=4096 configuration.
The separate documented simulation/deployment run binds 4096 robots, 24 steps, 98304 transitions/batch, 1500 updates, under twenty minutes and i9-11900k/RTX A6000 hardware.
The original note names Isaac Lab FPS anchors; preserve >900k DextrAH and >1.6M Franka environment-learning FPS at eight RTX PRO 6000 GPUs/16384 envs, distinct from toy throughput.
The CPU toggle is motivated by the specific RTX5090/AMD9800X3D versus two-RTX-PRO-6000/EPYC comparison, not a measured universal toy curve.
The target 2.2e8 transitions, 24 rollout steps as a chosen model input, cost seconds [0.02,4e-6,0.04,0.03,2.2e-5], fixed-budget assumption, sample grid and flat-marker x are authored.
Iterations=target/(envs*24); wall time=iterations*(sim+learn+CPU); FPS and crossover follow the fixed formula with units/formatting, not an empirical learning curve.
